info.title: Check Issues and Cancels
info.description: Submits one or more check issues and cancels (voids); issues and cancels in “Processing by Bank” status will be confirmed on the next business day.

post.summary: This service allows for the submission of one or more check issues and cancels (voids). Issues and cancels in “Processing by Bank” status will be confirmed on the next business day. Access CashPro Check Management to update, cancel or view the status of successfully processed items. Updates to Teller Positive Pay occur every 30 minutes from 9 a.m. to 9 p.m. Eastern Time Monday through Friday and will be available at our banking centers within one hour of being processed.

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: An unexpired access token to be used for this request (ex. 'Bearer [value]'). Length: 1-256

parameters.name: Content-Type
parameters.description: Identifies the content of the payload as JSON. Value = application/json

parameters.name: companyId
parameters.description: Unique company identifier - CashPro Company  ID. Length: 1-15

issueList.description: List of “Add Issues or Cancels” to be submitted

accountNumber.description:
The account number associated with the check issue or cancel
Length: 1 – 12 digits

issueAction.description:
Action to be performed
Value = “add Issue” or “cancel Issue”

payee.description:
Payee Name
Required for accounts subscribing to Payee Positive Pay
Length: 1 – 256

totalItems.description: Total number of items in the input list
Total number of items in the input list

accountNumber.description: The account number associated with the item submitted

amount.description: The check amount associated with the item submitted

checkNumber.description: The check number associated with the item submitted

issueAction.description: The action to be performed with the item submitted

issueDate.description: The check issue date associated with the item submitted

message.description: Response Message “Processing by Bank” or see list of Reason Codes and Messages.There may be multiple messages per item separated by a comma.
